description:
Create a new Epi Info 7 project named 'HouseholdSurvey' that structures a one-to-many relationship between households and family members.

1. Create a new project named 'HouseholdSurvey'.
2. Rename the default form to 'Household' (the parent form) and add these fields:
   - 'Address' (Text)
   - 'CensusTract' (Number)
   - 'VisitDate' (Date)
3. Create a linked child form named 'Member' using the 'Relate' button/command on the Household form. Label the button 'Add Family Member'.
4. In the 'Member' form, add these fields:
   - 'FullName' (Text)
   - 'Age' (Number)
   - 'Sex' (Legal Values/Dropdown with values 'Male' and 'Female')

Ensure all forms are saved.
